name: TextVQA
description: Visual question answering dataset requiring reasoning about text in images, with questions and answers grounded in scene text. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Singh, A., Natarajan, V., Shah, M., Jiang, Y., Chen, X., Batra, D., Parikh, D., & Rohrbach, M. (2019). Towards VQA Models That Can Read. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 8317–8326. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00851
